name: formel B

menus.name: formel B menu, five courses of your choice
menus.note: Five courses chosen from the 11 to 13 dishes on the menu; extra courses DKK 250 each; non-alcoholic pairing DKK 600; parties of six or more have a menu chosen by the head chef

alsoTry.name: Uformel
alsoTry.note: The group's more relaxed restaurant on Studiestræde near the City Hall Square, with a five-course menu or small plates (four to six a person suggested)

bookingOpens: Online through EasyTable, or by phone or email (info@formelb.dk).
cancellation: Cancellations must be made in writing to info@formelb.dk. A no-show is charged DKK 1,500 for each missing guest. Groups of 8 to 20 must confirm numbers six days ahead; later cancellations may be charged 75% of the agreed price.
groups: Parties of up to 35 can have a separate room, and up to 60 across the restaurant's two floors; enquiries through the form on the banquet page.
photoAlt: The front of formel B in Frederiksberg, Copenhagen, with planters by the steps
